content: Nneke kuabhaghula bhandu Lukinyo kwakya ubhaghulo
Maalongo bhangu, kiyaha munhyubhalila Bambo ghwetu Yesu Kilisito, Bambo ghwa ukulu, nkotoke kubhabhaghula bhandu,
kwa nhwano, kayingila mundu mu nyumba ya kuntundamila Chapanga, kahwala pete ya sahabu na mapinda gha maha, mbole kayingila kapukwa ywakahwalite lipinda litukutuku,
na mwenga mungunhwamila yula ywakahwalite mapinda gha maha na kunng'ombela, “Ghutame apa pamaha.” Na kunyuyuha kapukwa, “Ghwenga ghuyime pala, ebu ghutame pahi ugheghela na nenga.”
Bhuli! Aghwo chepa ubhaghulo mu mwenga? Bhuli aghwo ulamulo ghwenu ghungubhukana ng'obhe na mahwacho mahakata?
Maalongo bhangu nnyihwe, Chapanga kabhahaghula bhandu bhaabheghite kapukwa munnima aghu ili abheghe atopelo mu kunhyubhalila Kilisto na kukingama kwa bhala bhaampala.
Peni mwenga mungu ayuyuha makapukwa, bhuli? Abho atopelo bhanguabhonela ng'obhe na kubhatola kughenda mumabalasa?
Bhuli, ndo abho ng'obhe bhaaliligha lihina lya maha lya Bambo ghwetu?
Peni handa pamulitwihiliha lila lilaghilo lya kibhutwa handa palityekitwe mu malembo gha Chapanga, “Ghunpale nndamani ghwako handa paghulipala ghumene” Ndo maabhegha mungutenda gha maha.
Peni pamubhabhaghula bhandu mungutenda ulemwa, nagho malaghilo ghanguatosa mwenga kukita nhokela.
Ywakadunyula ngwiliho yimu mu malaghilo, katabhegha nhokelo ghwa kughadunyula malaghilo ghoha.
Kiyaha yuyula Chapang ywakalongilite, “Ghukotokye kubhegha ntyahe” kakilongela bhubho, “Ghukotoke kukoma.” Kya habho, payibhele ghukityaha ng'obhe, peni ghukoma, ghwenga ghughadunyula malaghilo.
Hino, nnongele na kutenda handa bhandu bhaapala kutoswa na malaghilo ghanakuyegha uhulu.
Kiyaha Chapanga katabhegha ng'obhe na luhungu pakantosa mundu ywakabhegha ng'obhe na luhungu. Peni luhungu lunguhotola toso.
Kuhyubhalila na kutenda pakapala Chapanga
Maalongo bhangu, yingutangatila niki mundu pakalongela kukita kanauhyubhalilo, peni kangubhoneha ng'obhe mandendelo? Bhuli, kuhyubhalila akwo kwahotola kunnopola?
Kwa nhwano, nnongo ebu nhacha kabhegha na mapinda matukutuku ebu ywanga hilyo.
Na yumoo ywenu pakaaghombela, “Nngende kwa uhihimilo makayote mwoto na makayukute,” kyanga kubhapegha ghala ghaaghapala mu kutama kwabhe?
Ubhwabhu abhu yingutangatila niki, uhyubhalilo ghweka kyanga mandendelo ndo uhyubhalila akwo kuhwegha.

Peni mundu kaalongela, “Ghwenga ghubhegha na uhyubhalilo, na nenga mmegha na mandendelo!” Maha, peni ghunmonehe mundu pakahotola kubhegha na uhyubhalilo kyanga mandendelo, na nenga ndakubhoneha uhyubhalilo ghwangu kwa mandendelo ghangu.
Ghwenga ghunguhyubhalila kukita Chapanga ndo yumo, ghungutenda maha. Mandilu nabho bhanguhyubhalila na kuloghoya kwa lyogha.
Nghwenga ndo nbhughabhugha! Ghungubhona ng'obhe kukita uhyubhalilo kyanga mandendelo ghuhwegha?
Bhuli, tate ghwetu Ibulahimu kakimokola bhuli kuyitikilwa kukita ghwa maha muulongolo ghwa Chapanga? Kwa mandendelo ghake, pala pakanbhuhite mwana ghwake Isaka kubhegha nyambi mu likuta.
Hinu ghungubhona kukita kuhyubhalila kwake kukibhegha papamu na mandendelo ghake, kuhyubhalila kwake kukitwihilika kubhukana na mandendelo ghake.

Habho ghakitwihilika ghala malembo gha Chapanga ghaalongelilte, “Ibulahimu kakinhyubhalila Chapanga na kwa kuhyubhalila kwake kakiyitikilwa kukita ndo mundu ywa maha muulongolo ghwa Chapanga,” na habho Ibulahimu kakikemwa ghanja ghwa Chapanga.
Mungubhona kukita mungu kaayitikilwa kukita ghwa maha muulongolo ghwa Chapanga kwa mandendelo ghake, na kata kwa kuhyubhalila ghweka.

Rahabu ywakabheghite ntyahe ndo nhwano ghungi, ywombe kakibhonekana ghwa maha muulongolo ghwa Chapanga kwa mandendelo ghake, pala pakaahihite bhala ahingukiha kitami na kubhatangatila abhuke kwa kupitila njila yingi.
Hinu, handa bhula mmili kyanga nhuki ghuhwegha, ubhwabhu abhu kuhyubhalila kyanga mandendelo ndo kuhwegha.
